import crypto from 'node:crypto'

import { hashPassword } from '@api/lib/auth/hashPassword'
import { isUserActive } from '@api/lib/auth/isUserActive'
import { bypassDb as db } from '@api/lib/db'

export async function authenticateUser(email: string, password: string) {
  const user = await db.user.findFirst({
    where: {
      hashedPassword: {
        not: '',
      },
      email: {
        equals: email,
        mode: 'insensitive',
      },
    },
  })
  if (!user || !isUserActive(user)) {
    return null
  }

  const [hashedPassword, salt] = hashPassword(password, {
    salt: user.salt,
  })
  if (!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(user.hashedPassword), Buffer.from(hashedPassword))) {
    return null
  }
  return {
    id: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    firstName: user.firstName,
    lastName: user.lastName,
    fullName: user.fullName,
  }
}
